svg.title: NextStep — Figma Master Design & Prototype Canvas

g.text: Master Visual Flow Diagram & Importable Vector Artboards (Visual flow diagram; wire native Figma prototype connections after import)
Tell me what's happening. You don't have to organize it first.
Viva is at 10am tomorrow, laptop won't boot,
my project partner has been ignoring my calls
for 2 days, and my dad just got admitted to
a hospital in Surat. I'm in Pune.
Supports long text, mixed language / Hinglish
Taking a breath before we process…
Dad admitted to hospital in Surat
Do you need to travel to
Yes, I need to go tonight
Here's what matters most right now
One clear step at a time. The rest is organized below.
Call whoever is with your dad now:
Ask if they need you in Surat tonight.
Call family to confirm travel needs tonight
This decides whether you need to catch a bus/train
tonight, which directly affects the morning viva.
Viva at 10am tomorrow — Email guide tonight
Regarding: "Call whoever is with your dad now"
since we last talked. What's different?
e.g. Laptop is fixed, or viva moved…
PROTOTYPE BRANCHES: CALM MODE, RECOVERY, CORRECTION, CONTRADICTION & TOKENS
When work, exams, and family all feel heavy
at once, feeling exhausted makes complete sense.
LET'S FOCUS ON WHAT YOU NEED IN THIS MOMENT:
Focus on the next few minutes
NextStep does not replace crisis or healthcare professionals.
Branch S7: Recovery ("That didn't go as expected")
Your manager replied angrily and copied HR.
Current goal: Cool things down, don't win argument.
Help me decide what to do next
Edit any specific item. You don't have to restart.
Dad admitted to hospital in Surat
Laptop won't boot before the viva
Branch S3: Contradiction ("I don't want to guess")
You mentioned both in your message.
